release_evidence.reason: The original Release run (36256896376) failed only at the npm:@redact-secret/core publish job's pre-publish 'Qualify release' gate (npm run release:check -> npm run ci -> examples:test), on an ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for the externally published @redact-secret/adapter-ai-context@0.1.0-alpha.1 used only by the examples/mcp-redact golden-path test, not a redact-secret artifact or registry defect. The actual npm-publish command for the core facade never ran in that job, so registry_state and this package's artifact digest were recorded null/unpublished. Every other publish job in the same run succeeded: both crates, all nine PyPI files, and all nine npm dependency (addon/wasm) packages. Reconcile Release (36257774995 dry-run, 36257859108 authorized repair) does not re-run the release:check gate; it published the already-qualified core tarball directly, verified all eight Node install lanes and Chromium, and created the annotated tag. This record combines the original run's preserved digests/registry snapshot, the reconcile run's verification and tag, and registries independently checked live on 2026-09-28.
